definitions.explanation: a vehicle or wheeled device used to move goods, materials, or equipment from one place to another

examples.japanese: {運搬車|うんぱんしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: To carry luggage with a transport cart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧{運搬車|うんぱんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Electric transport vehicles are used in the factory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{資材|しざい}→資材：19470_shizai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{運搬車|うんぱんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何台|なんだい}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{出入|でい}り→出入り：06609_deiri⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Several large transport vehicles are going in and out of the construction site to carry materials.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{運搬|うんぱん}→運搬：09231_unpan⟧ (transport, conveyance) and ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle). Can refer to anything from small hand carts to large industrial vehicles, depending on context. Most commonly used in industrial, construction, and logistics settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧{運搬車|うんぱんしゃ}: electric transport vehicle
- {手押|てお}し{運搬車|うんぱんしゃ}: push cart
- {運搬車|うんぱんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{操作|そうさ}する→操作する：18999_sousasuru⟧: to operate a transport vehicle
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧{運搬車|うんぱんしゃ}: luggage carrier

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{台車|だいしゃ}→台車：18474_daisha⟧: hand cart, dolly — a simple wheeled platform for moving goods
- ⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧: truck — a motor vehicle for transporting goods on roads
- フォークリフト: forklift — a powered industrial truck for lifting and moving pallets
